name: ICETEX
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, GA4 through Tag Manager, and a sitemap in robots.txt. But 19 inner pages name https://web.icetex.gov.co/ as their canonical, which asks search engines to index the home instead.
lesson: Each page's canonical should be its own URL. A template that defaults to the home URL hides every inner page.
summary: web.icetex.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 19 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /portal → /, /nosotros → /, /el-icetex/informacion-institucional → /, /el-icetex/contratacion → / and 15 more. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 4 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: COOKIE_SUPPORT, GUEST_LANGUAGE_ID, JSESSIONID, cookiesession1. Set on /portal, /nosotros, /el-icetex/informacion-institucional and 17 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 406 ms
Every page has a meta description
